title: Voyager's Tales
author: Richard Hakluyt
description: "Voyager's Tales" by Richard Hakluyt is a historical account written in the late 16th century.
longDescription: This work is a compilation of narratives detailing the voyages and adventures of various explorers and the experiences of Englishmen abroad during the Age of Discovery.

authorInfo.bio: Richard Hakluyt (–1616) wrote Voyager's Tales. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.
